perplexity.description:
Gizmodrome is the self-titled debut album by the supergroup Gizmodrome, released in September 2017 on Ear Music. The band features Stewart Copeland (The Police), Adrian Belew (King Crimson), Mark King (Level 42), and Vittorio Cosma (PFM), combining their diverse backgrounds in rock, funk, and progressive music. The album blends energetic rock with funk-infused rhythms, intricate guitar work, and playful, syncopated arrangements. Tracks like "Zombies in the Mall" and "Stay Ready" showcase Copeland's quirky songwriting and the group's tight musicianship, while songs such as "Man in the Mountain" and "Spin This" highlight their ability to merge funk, soul, and progressive rock elements into a cohesive sound.

As the first release from this all-star collaboration, Gizmodrome stands out in the discographies of its members for its experimental spirit and genre-blurring approach. The album draws on Copeland's earlier work, including reworked material from his Klark Kent project, and incorporates influences from each member's storied career. Upon release, Gizmodrome received positive attention for its creativity and musicianship, peaking at No. 14 on the UK Independent Albums chart. Critics praised the album for its dynamic energy and the seamless interplay between its accomplished players, marking it as a notable entry in the late-career output of its members.
